_comment: Revvel MCP configuration — see docs/Master_Inventory/MCP_STANDARD.md and docs/MCP_REVVEL_CATALOG.md for full details.

rvvel-affiliate-links._comment: 8 tools for the Revvel affiliate link ecosystem. See AGENTS.md for tool list.
rvvel-affiliate-links.disabledReason: Server not yet deployed. Enable once mcp-servers/affiliate-links/ is built and DATABASE_URL is configured.

code-review._comment: 10 tools for automated code quality enforcement. See AGENTS.md for tool list.
code-review.disabledReason: Server not yet deployed. Enable once mcp-servers/code-review/ is built.

axion-planetary._comment: Axion Planetary MCP — SAR-to-optical foundation model for cloud-free Earth observation. See docs/AXION_PLANETARY_MCP.md. Tools: axion_sar2optical, axion_describe_sar, axion_batch_convert, axion_status.
axion-planetary.disabledReason: Enable once growlingeyes/ deps are installed: pip install -r growlingeyes/requirements.txt

doppler._comment: DoppleMCP — 11 tools for Doppler secrets management: secrets CRUD, projects, tokens, health. See growlingeyes/doppemcp/README.md. OPTIONAL: Doppler integration is not required for core functionality. Enable only when you have acquired Doppler credentials independently.
doppler.disabledReason: Disabled until credentials are acquired. To enable: (1) Sign up at doppler.com, (2) Create project 'revvel-standards', (3) Generate service token, (4) Set DOPPLER_TOKEN env var, (5) Install: cd growlingeyes/doppemcp && pip install -e .

meilisearch._comment: MeiliSearch MCP — 8 tools for product/user-facing search: index management, document CRUD, search, settings. See mcp-servers/meilisearch-mcp/README.md. HIGH PRIORITY — Revenue blocker (search affects conversions).
meilisearch.disabledReason: Enable once MeiliSearch is installed and configured. To enable: (1) Run `docker compose up -d` in poc/meilisearch/ OR provision MeiliSearch Cloud, (2) Set MEILI_HOST and MEILI_KEY in your .env (see .env.example) — WARNING: the 'masterKey' fallback is a local-dev default ONLY; always set a strong MEILI_KEY before enabling in production, (3) Install: cd mcp-servers/meilisearch-mcp && pip install -e ., (4) Remove this disabled entry.

github-issues-enhanced._comment: Enhanced GitHub Issues MCP — 6 tools for issue automation: create_issue_with_automation, bulk_label_issues, smart_issue_search, issue_timeline_summary, auto_triage_issue, issue_metrics. See mcp-servers/github-issues/README.md and docs/GITHUB_ISSUES_UI_ENHANCEMENTS.md.
github-issues-enhanced.disabledReason: Enable once dependencies are installed: cd mcp-servers/github-issues && npm install — then set GITHUB_TOKEN.

wr-pr-control-plane._comment: WR / PR Control Plane MCP — GitHub-native intake packet, credential readiness, and 2026 blueprint orchestration contract for Composio + Firecrawl + Obot + FastMCP. See mcp-servers/wr-control-plane/README.md.
wr-pr-control-plane.disabledReason: Enable after installing the local server (cd mcp-servers/wr-control-plane && uv pip install -e .) and provisioning credentials in your secrets manager: GITHUB_TOKEN, COMPOSIO_API_KEY, OBOT_BASE_URL, and OBOT_IDP_CONFIG. FIRECRAWL_API_KEY and TAVILY_API_KEY are strongly recommended when WRs include docs, PDFs, or external research targets.

ensemble-ahp-engine._comment: WR-4483 M1 Heterogeneous-Ensemble AHP Decision Engine (FastMCP). Steps 1-7 only: STRUCTURE→CHECK with 3 distinct model-family judges, geometric-mean aggregate, CR + per-cell CV dispersion, FAILURE-LEDGER JSONL. See mcp-servers/ensemble-ahp-engine/README.md.
ensemble-ahp-engine.disabledReason: Enable after: cd mcp-servers/ensemble-ahp-engine && pip install -e . (or uv pip install -e .). Without OPENROUTER_API_KEY the engine runs labelled mock judges so steps 1-7 still complete offline. Live heterogeneous judges require a funded OpenRouter key (WR-4481 keyless failover still applies on 402/429).

chrome-devtools-mcp._comment: Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) as MCP tools. Fork: midnghtsapphire/chrome-devtools-mcp. Docs: docs/MCP_REVVEL_CATALOG.md. SECURITY: token/cookie tools scoped to localhost and authorized test origins ONLY.
chrome-devtools-mcp.disabledReason: Enable only for local dev or CI E2E testing. Prerequisites: (1) Start Chrome with --remote-debugging-port=9222 --user-data-dir=/tmp/cdp-test-profile, (2) Clone the fork: git clone https://github.com/midnghtsapphire/chrome-devtools-mcp, (3) npm install in the fork dir, (4) Set CHROME_DEVTOOLS_MCP_PATH to the fork's entry point (e.g. /path/to/chrome-devtools-mcp/dist/index.js), (5) Set CHROME_DEBUG_PORT=9222 in .env. SECURITY REQUIREMENT: Only call cdp_get_cookies, cdp_get_local_storage, cdp_get_session_storage, and cdp_network_intercept against localhost or test origins you own. Never use against production user sessions.
